nodes.name: adapt.md
nodes.summary: Guide for adapting an existing design to a new screen size, device, platform, or use case, framing adaptation as rethinking the experience rather than scaling it.

nodes.name: animate.md
nodes.summary: Reference for adding purposeful motion that conveys state, feedback, and hierarchy, with register-specific guidance and a bias toward cutting decorative animation.

nodes.name: audit.md
nodes.summary: Technical quality audit procedure scoring an implementation across five measurable dimensions (0-4) and producing a report without fixing issues.

nodes.name: bolder.md
nodes.summary: Guide for increasing visual impact through stronger hierarchy, committed scale, and decisive type, explicitly rejecting gradient/glassmorphism/neon cliches.

nodes.name: brand.md
nodes.summary: Defines the brand register, where design is the product (landing pages, marketing, portfolios), including genre-spanning principles and font selection procedure.

nodes.name: clarify.md
nodes.summary: Procedure for finding and rewriting vague or confusing interface copy into specific, task-completing text tailored to audience and mental state.

nodes.name: codex.md
nodes.summary: Visual direction and raster asset production steps for the craft flow when the harness supports native image generation (Codex image_gen).

nodes.name: colorize.md
nodes.summary: Guide for replacing timid grayscale or single-accent palettes with a strategic color strategy and hue family applied with intent.

nodes.name: craft.md
nodes.summary: Craft flow: build a feature to studio quality by shaping the design, landing visual direction, writing production code, and iterating in-browser; requires PRODUCT.md and a register reference.

nodes.name: critique.md
nodes.summary: Design critique procedure combining an independent design review and detector/browser evidence into a synthesized critique with a persisted snapshot and follow-up prompt.

nodes.name: delight.md
nodes.summary: Guide for adding personality and unexpected polish only at moments that earn it, with domain-appropriate tone (playful, professional, elegant).

nodes.name: distill.md
nodes.summary: Procedure for stripping a design to its essence by removing redundant elements, repeated information, and decorative noise.

nodes.name: document.md
nodes.summary: Instructions for generating a DESIGN.md in the Google Stitch format: YAML token frontmatter plus six fixed markdown sections capturing the visual system.

nodes.name: extract.md
nodes.summary: Extract flow for identifying reusable patterns, components, and tokens and consolidating them into the project's design system.

nodes.name: harden.md
nodes.summary: Guide for hardening interfaces against extreme inputs, errors, long/RTL text, and poor network conditions so designs survive real-world data.

nodes.name: hooks.md
nodes.summary: Documents the /impeccable hooks command that installs or manages the PostToolUse design-detector hook on design-relevant file edits.

nodes.name: init.md
nodes.summary: Init flow that crawls the codebase once to write PRODUCT.md (strategy/register) and DESIGN.md (visual system) for the project.

nodes.name: interaction-design.md
nodes.summary: Reference on interaction design covering the eight interactive states every element needs and their visual treatments.

nodes.name: layout.md
nodes.summary: Guide for fixing layout structure (monotone spacing, weak hierarchy, identical grids) through rhythm, asymmetry, and fluid spacing per register.

nodes.name: live.md
nodes.summary: Documents the interactive live variant mode: selecting elements in the browser, choosing a design action, and hot-swapping AI-generated HTML+CSS variants via HMR.
